question: The Sattriya Dance in Assam is inspired by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** the Bhakti Movement.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sattriya Dance is a classical dance form of Assam that originated in the 15th century.**
 
• It is inspired by the Bhakti Movement, which emphasizes devotion and love for** God as the path to salvation.**
 
• The dance form was developed by the Vaishnavite saint and reformer Srimanta Sankardeva, who used it as a means to spread the **message of Bhakti among the masses.**
 
• Sattriya Dance was traditionally performed as part of the** religious rituals in the Sattras (monasteries) of Assam, but it has now gained recognition as a standalone art form**.
 
• The other options are not related to the Sattriya Dance.
 
• The Shakti Movement refers to the worship of the divine feminine, Tantrism is a set of esoteric practices in Hinduism and Buddhism, and the Sufi Movement is a mystical tradition in Islam.
